newsitem.title: USA: FSA qualifies 20 bond issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: FSA qualifies 20 bond issues for insurance.

text.p: Financial Security Assurance said on Tuesday that it qualified for bond insurance the following 20 municipal bond issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Alum Rock Elem SD, Calif., $12 million general obligations.
--Waukee Comm SD, Iowa, $2.3 million school GOs.
--Evansville Wtr Dist, Ind., $13.250 million water bonds.
--Agawam, Mass., $3.04 million muni purpose loan GOs.
--New Hampshire Muni BD BK, $27.845 million Series A & B.
--Brewster CSD, N.Y., $9.6 million school district bonds.
--Evans-Brant CSD, N.Y., $6.866 million school district bonds.
--Shikellamy SD, Pa., $4.995 million GOs is a direct purchase.
--Williamson County, Texas, $3 million GOs, $9.1 million tax & rev certificates and $15 million road bonds.
